name: Tickatus
guide_text: The best tier 1 spells are discover tier 1 or rockin' and rollin'. The best tier 2 spell is On the House. The best tier 3 spells are Top Shelf and Midflayer Goggles.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up on turn 8 and sell it on that turn, must not sell it before turn 8. This'll give you tier 3 spells that provide great value, the best ones being steal shop or golden in shop or discover 6 drop. Use your second set of buddies on turn 12. All of them are good depending on what you need.
